difficulty_reason: After standard Mackey/Frobenius reciprocity, Littlewood–Richardson and Young-rule foundations, the selected recursion still requires a new skew restriction calculation for wreath-product induced characters, including the double-coset/sign decomposition and its extension from one-row to arbitrary outer partitions. This new character-operator construction and its general recursive consequence are retained as one unit, with no separate helper or unrelated Sylow count.
